content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no direct description of the compound. We can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm (triplet) etc. Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm. We need to decide minimal experiments. Probably get proton NMR first. Use tool proton_nmr_spectra (requires SMILES? It says for a given SMILES string. But we don't have SMILES. The sample is "at hand". The tool carbon_nmr_spectra and proton_nmr_spectra take no arguments. They likely use the sample at hand. So we can call proton_nmr_spectra. Then analyze peaks for methyl groups. Let's do that.
